The '''1992–93 Scottish Premier Division''' season ended in success for the [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] who won the title by nine points from nearest rivals [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]] and 13 points above third place rival [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] to clinch five titles in a row. [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]] and [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]] finished 11th and 12th respectively and were relegated to the [[Scottish Football League First Division|First Division]].
